sql:
SELECT P.ID, P.SEX 
FROM Patient P 
WHERE P.ID IN (
    SELECT E.ID 
    FROM Examination E 
    WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND E.`aCL IgG` > 10 AND E.`aCL IgG` < 17
) AND P.Birthday IN (
    SELECT MIN(P.Birthday) 
    FROM Patient P 
    JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID 
    WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND E.`aCL IgG` > 10 AND E.`aCL IgG` < 17
)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1
